title: INNOZHERO: A major step towards capturing carbon emissions from waste
summary: CINEA reports that the INNOZHERO carbon capture project in Helsingborg, Sweden, has reached its Final Investment Decision. It is described as one of Europe's first large-scale carbon capture facilities at a waste-to-energy plant and is supported by the EU Innovation Fund.
why_it_matters: A firm new Swedish capture source moves to FID, adding confirmed volume to southern-Sweden CO2 flows that need port, shipping and storage capacity.
